tools.name: quote
tools.description: Use when an agent needs the latest market price of a listed instrument: AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, SPY, ^GSPC (S&P 500), ^IXIC, EURUSD=X, GC=F (gold futures), BTC-USD, 7203.T (Tokyo), VOW3.DE (Xetra). Returns price, previous close, absolute and percent change, day high/low, volume, 52-week high/low, exchange

tools.name: quotes
tools.description: Use to price a watchlist or portfolio in one paid call: pass up to 10 comma-separated Yahoo-style tickers (e.g. AAPL,MSFT,NVDA,SPY,BTC-USD). Each item has the same fields as /v1/quote; unknown symbols are listed in "notFound" instead of failing the whole call. Charged only if at least one symbol res

tools.name: history
tools.description: Use for charts, backtests, returns and volatility: returns open/high/low/close/adjusted close/volume bars for one ticker over a range (1d, 5d, 1mo, 3mo, 6mo, ytd, 1y, 2y, 5y, 10y, max) at an interval (5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 1d, 1wk, 1mo; intraday 5m-30m only up to 1mo, 1h up to 2y). Also returns period r

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use to resolve a company or asset name to a tradable ticker before calling /v1/quote or /v1/history: "apple" -> AAPL, "s&p 500" -> ^GSPC, "volkswagen" -> VOW3.DE, "bitcoin" -> BTC-USD. Returns up to 20 matches with symbol, short/long name, quote type (EQUITY, ETF, INDEX, MUTUALFUND, CURRENCY, CRYPTO

tools.name: crypto
tools.description: Use for cryptocurrency prices across thousands of coins and tokens: pass CoinGecko ids (bitcoin,ethereum,solana; up to 25) or ticker symbols (BTC,ETH,SOL; up to 5, resolved to the highest-ranked coin with that symbol). Returns price, 24h change %, market cap, 24h volume and last-updated time per coi

tools.name: crypto_search
tools.description: Use to resolve a coin or token name/ticker ("solana", "pepe", "usdc") to its CoinGecko id for /v1/crypto. Returns up to 25 matches ordered by CoinGecko relevance with id, name, symbol, market-cap rank and logo thumbnail. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.001 per successful call; call without payment

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use to resolve a company or asset name to a tradable ticker before calling /v1/quote or /v1/history: "apple" -> AAPL, "s&p 500" -> ^GSPC, "volkswagen" -> VOW3.D…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
